name: Furiroun
source:
A starfish alien who has a weak demeanor and is always timid. Perhaps the thing she is carrying on her back is heavy and slowing her down. She is in fact an aggressive carnivore and will make any male who treats her kindly her mate.

She's mostly naked and has no special equipment or power. She uses her exposed voluptuous body to lure men and inject with an aphrodisiac rendering them unable to runaway from her. She likes taking her time and spend alone time with her chosen male. She will thoroughly enjoy herself with him.

The way she loves and dedicates herself to her chosen male can only ever be described as "yandere".
